name: Ivno Payment Gateway
author: ivno

sections.description:
Welcome to the Ivno Payment Gateway—a versatile WooCommerce payment gateway that changes how high-risk businesses handle payments by combining traditional fiat payment methods with instant USDC payouts. Whether you are operating in IPTV, CBD, Peptides, Adult content, or Gaming, our platform ensures your business stays live and thriving. Accept global fiat payments by credit / debit card, Apple Pay & GPay today. Receive instant USDC payouts, bypassing traditional banking delays and restrictions.

Key Benefits for Merchants

  • Instant Access: Start accepting payments immediately after installation.
  • Zero KYC Required: Start accepting payments immediately without lengthy verification processes for your merchant account.
  • No Chargebacks: All payments are final and irreversible, providing full chargeback protection.
  • 24/7 Support: Dedicated customer support team available around the clock.
  • Custom Integration: Easily customizable checkout to perfectly match your store’s theme.

Versatile Features

  • Multi-Currency Support: Accept global payments smoothly via Credit/Debit card, Apple Pay, and GPay.
  • Automatic Currency Conversion: Seamless conversion from fiat to USDC, featuring a built-in currency converter for U.S. Dollar (USD), Euro (EUR), Japanese Yen (JPY), Pound Sterling (GBP), Chinese Renminbi (CNY), Australian Dollar (AUD), Canadian Dollar (CAD), Swiss Franc (CHF), Hong Kong Dollar (HKD), Singapore Dollar (SGD), Indian Rupee (INR), South Korean Won (KRW), Nigerian Naira (NGN), South African Rand (ZAR), and United Arab Emirates Dirham (AED).
  • Real-Time Transaction Monitoring: Track all your transactions in real-time and export them by status or date filters directly from your merchant dashboard.
  • Secure Processing: Enterprise-grade security with encrypted transactions and full chargeback protection for ultimate peace of mind.
  • Built-In KYC Discounts: Automatically apply a percentage or fixed discount to reward customers for completing verification steps, complete with strict margin protection rules to safeguard your profits.
  • Automated Order Management: Enjoy automatic order status updates, payment verification, and automated cart abandonment recovery.
  • Webhook Signature Verification: Secure WooCommerce order status updates using a dedicated webhook secret copied from your Ivno Merchant Dashboard.
  • Instant USDC Payouts: Receive your funds instantly with an unlimited monthly volume cap.
  • Versatile Invoicing: Generate direct payment links, recurring subscription links, and detailed invoice links.
  • Mobile-Ready Payments: Utilize our built-in QR code generator for swift and accessible payments.
  • Branded Checkout & Whitelabel: Deliver a user-friendly checkout experience that seamlessly matches your brand identity.
  • Developer & E-commerce Ready: Connect instantly via the Ivno WooCommerce plugin or build custom solutions using our Developer APIs and documentation.
  • Dedicated 24/7 Support: Access our reliable customer support team around the clock for any assistance.

Privacy, Security & Compliance

This gateway processes payment information with enterprise-level safety:
* End-to-end SSL/TLS encryption for all transactions.
* PCI DSS compliant processing through secure provider endpoints.
* No storage of sensitive credit card data on your server.
* Advanced anti-fraud protection and secure USDC wallet integration.
* Dedicated webhook signature verification support.
* Fully GPL-compatible (GPLv3) and strictly follows WooCommerce best practices.

Helpful Links

  • Apply Now: https://ivno.io/#apply
  • Merchant Dashboard: https://app.ivno.io/merchant-dashboard/
  • API Documentation: https://ivno.io/api-docs
  • Supported Industries: https://ivno.io/industries/ (We are not limited to these industries at all)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ivno-payment-gateway/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Ivno Payment Gateway.
  4. Enable the gateway and enter your API Key and API Secret from your Ivno Merchant Dashboard.
  5. Copy the Webhook URL shown inside the WooCommerce Ivno settings.
  6. Go to Ivno Merchant Dashboard → Webhooks and paste that WooCommerce Webhook URL into the Webhook URL field.
  7. Copy the Webhook Secret from Ivno Merchant Dashboard → Webhooks.
  8. Paste that Webhook Secret into the Webhook Secret field inside the WooCommerce Ivno gateway settings.
  9. Save your WooCommerce settings.
  10. Go to Ivno Merchant Dashboard and make sure your USDC (Polygon network) payout wallet is configured.
  11. Test a payment to confirm the order automatically updates from Pending Payment to Processing or Completed.
sections.faq:
What payment methods does Ivno support?

Ivno allows you to accept standard fiat payments including major Credit/Debit Cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Ivno is built on a fiat-on-ramp technology. In fiat on-ramp, customers experience a familiar e-commerce checkout using their credit card or mobile wallet. Behind the scenes, our licensed fiat-to-crypto partners instantly convert their payment into USDC and deposit it directly into your connected USDC Polygon wallet instantly or as soon as the transaction clears in the blockchain.

What is the minimum order amount?

The minimum allowed amount per transaction is $20. Any order or payment link created for less than $20 will not be processed. We recommend configuring a minimum cart total in your store or e-commerce plugin settings to prevent customers from encountering checkout errors.

Why does Ivno payout in USDC?

USDC is a fully backed stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the US Dollar. Payouts in USDC on the Polygon network allow us to bypass traditional banking delays and international wire fees, delivering your funds instantly and globally without borders.

What payout wallet do I need?

You need a cryptocurrency wallet that supports the Polygon network and can receive USDC tokens. We strongly recommend using a non-custodial wallet like MetaMask, Exodus, or a hardware wallet like Ledger. Please note that you should not use a deposit address from a centralized exchange (such as Binance or Coinbase), as they may not recognize the incoming transaction or could impose delays and additional fees. Most of our merchants smartly receive their payouts into a non-custodial USDC wallet first and then transfer the funds to their second USDC (polygon network) wallet in a centralized exchange like Binance later.

What are the processing fees?

Because fiat payments are converted into cryptocurrency by licensed partners, there are processing costs involved. Ivno charges a flat fee of 12%. In your merchant dashboard settings, you have three options to decide who pays the ivno admin fee: (1) Pass 100% of the Ivno admin fee to your customer, or (2) You pay 100% of the Ivno admin fee or (3) You split the ivno admin fee 50/50 between you and your customer.

Which countries are supported?

Ivno is truly global. Merchants from almost anywhere in the world can integrate our gateway to receive USDC, while your customers can pay you globally using their credit/debit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay, subject only to standard international gateway compliance. We do not accept merchants from the following prohibited jurisdictions: Afghanistan, Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, Venezuela, and occupied regions of Ukraine.

How does the payment process work?

Customers experience a familiar e-commerce checkout using their credit card or mobile wallet. Behind the scenes, our licensed fiat-to-crypto partners instantly convert their payment into USDC and deposit it directly into your connected Polygon wallet.

Why do customers need KYC?

Because fiat currency is being converted into cryptocurrency, international financial regulations require licensed payment providers to perform standard “Know Your Customer” (KYC) checks. This ensures a highly secure environment and protects against fraud and chargebacks.

Do customers repeat KYC each time?

No. Once a customer successfully verifies their identity with a specific provider, their profile is saved. Subsequent checkouts will be vastly accelerated, often requiring just a quick confirmation without re-uploading documents.

How to reduce KYC cart abandonment?

While identity verification keeps payments secure, extra steps can sometimes cause checkout hesitation. We highly recommend turning that friction into a fast conversion by rewarding your customers.

RECOMMENDED! Utilize the Ivno Payment Discount feature built directly into this plugin. From your WooCommerce settings, you can automatically apply a percentage (e.g., 10%) or fixed discount to visually reward customers when they select Ivno at checkout. To safely protect your profits, this discount features a Margin Protection safety net: it only activates on carts of $50 or more, and mathematically guarantees your final checkout total will never drop below $50 (preventing you from accidentally giving away inventory from a pricing typo).

How long does KYC take?

For smaller purchases, “light KYC” utilizing Open Banking can take just seconds. If full document verification is required for larger amounts, the automated system typically processes and approves the user in just 1 to 5 minutes.

How quickly can I access my funds with Ivno?

Instantly. As soon as the customer’s transaction is confirmed by the provider, the USDC is deposited directly into your designated USDC (Polygon network) wallet address. You have immediate access and full control over your money.

How secure is Ivno’s payment system?

Ivno is incredibly secure. We utilize bank-grade encryption, and all fiat transactions are processed by globally licensed, PCI-compliant gateway partners. Because payouts are sent directly to your decentralized wallet, you never run the risk of a centralized platform freezing your account balance.

How do webhooks work with WooCommerce?

The Ivno WooCommerce plugin uses your configured Webhook URL and Webhook Secret to verify signed webhook notifications from Ivno. This allows WooCommerce to automatically update the order from Pending Payment to Processing or Completed after a successful payment.

Where do I find the Webhook URL and Webhook Secret?

The WooCommerce plugin shows you the exact Webhook URL to use. You must paste that URL into Ivno Merchant Dashboard → Webhooks. Then copy the Webhook Secret from the same Webhooks tab in the Ivno Merchant Dashboard and paste it back into the WooCommerce plugin settings.

How do I integrate Ivno with my store?

We offer a plug-and-play extension for WooCommerce that can be installed in minutes. For custom websites, you can utilize our robust REST API, or generate simple checkout links and QR codes directly from your merchant dashboard.

What happens if a customer’s payment fails?

If a transaction is declined by the customer’s bank or fails the provider’s security checks, the user is notified immediately on the checkout screen. No funds are captured, and the customer can simply retry the purchase using an alternative payment method.

What kind of support does Ivno offer?

We provide comprehensive API documentation, detailed integration guides, and dedicated Telegram and email support to ensure your store is successfully set up and processing payments smoothly.
sections.changelog:
1.7.5

  • Added dedicated Webhook Secret support to the WooCommerce gateway settings.
  • Updated webhook verification to use the correct Ivno webhook secret instead of relying on the API secret.
  • Added merchant guidance for copying the Webhook URL and Webhook Secret from the Ivno Merchant Dashboard.
  • Improved automatic WooCommerce order status update reliability after successful payments.
  • Improved transport security by enabling stricter outbound SSL verification for API requests.

1.7.4

  • Accept Credit/Debit Cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay with instant USDC payouts.
  • Added Cart Abandonment Recovery, Native Modal Checkout, and KYC Discounts.
